title: Chit Signed By W.J.H. Thorburn At Palace Hotel, Bearing Date Of June 1, 1931

page_data.en:
Form No. 2

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
9.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 241/19
Section 2.
Date August 6, 1931.

Subject (in full) Chit signed by W.J.H. Thorburn at Palace Hotel, bearing date
of June 1, 1931.

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Ross.

According to Mr. Schwartz, manager of the Palace
Hotel Buffet, the takings of the bar are collected daily at 11 p.m.
after which hour chits are stamped with the next day's date, there-
fore chit No. 6 bearing the date of June 1, was signed by Thorburn
between 11 p.m. and 12 m.n. on May 31.
The figures I 9 on the top left hand corner of
the chit represent respectively
I.The Cashier on duty during the evening.
9.The Snack Restaurant.
In connection with this matter Thorburn,
according to one of the Chinese cashiers, had dinner on May 31,
in the Snack Restaurant in company with a foreign lady who, from
her description appears to be identical with Mrs. Roberts.

D.B. Ross
D. I.
The Palace Hotel request that the original chit be re-
turned to them. - I suggest that copy be prepared
Officer i/c Special Branch. and chit be handed to
Mr Mossop.
S.B.R.
c/s

D.C. (Crime),
Subject to your approval,
Det. Insp. Ross will hand a copy of the
report and the chit to Mr Mossop.
O. i/c Sp. Br.

S2,
For attention please.
7:8:31.

Jane / D.B.R / 9/8.

9.
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 241/19
第2科。
日期：1931年8月6日。

事由（全称） W.J.H. Thorburn 于华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）签署的签单，日期为1931年6月1日。

由 D. I. Ross 制作并呈报。

据华懋饭店自助餐部经理 Schwartz 先生称，酒吧营收每日于晚上11点结算，在此时间之后签署的签单均加盖次日日期，因此，日期为6月1日的第6号签单系 Thorburn 于5月31日晚上11点至午夜12点之间签署。
签单左上角的数字 I 9 分别代表：
I. 当晚值班的收银员。
9. 小吃餐厅。
关于此事，据一名中国收银员称，Thorburn 于5月31日晚在小吃餐厅与一位外籍女士共进晚餐，根据描述，该女士似乎即为 Roberts 夫人。

D.B. Ross
侦探督察
华懋饭店要求归还原始签单。——我建议制备副本
特别股主管警官。并将签单交给
Mossop 先生。
特别股登记处。
抄送

副总监（刑事），
如蒙批准，
侦探督察 Ross 将把本报告副本及签单交给 Mossop 先生。
特别股主管。

S2，
请予关注。
31年8月7日。

Jane / D.B.R / 8月9日。
